note: conversion_rate and AOV are held by construction: scaling transactions and revenue by the same factor as sessions leaves transactions/sessions and revenue/transactions unchanged for this segment, up to per-row integer rounding at the fact_sessions grain.
dates_revision: re-screened 2026-09-27; supersedes the original 2016-10-24/11-18/12-20/2017-01-16/02-10 set, which passed the top-level composed-detector exclusion filter (PLAN.md 5.1) but not a per-channel real-noise check. See notes/PLAN.md 5.1, 'I1 dates re-screened'.

pass_condition.description: Organic Search must be the channel-dimension segment with the largest |actual - expected| for sessions, with actual < expected (correctly signed), and verdict=strong (implies q<0.05).
pass_condition.revenue_factor_sessions_share: reported only, not gated (see PLAN.md 5.2 revision note)

pass_condition_revision: revised 2026-09-27 from a %-share-threshold design (within_share_min=0.70, other_channel_share_max=0.30, revenue_factor_sessions_share_min=0.60) to a magnitude-rank design, for the same reason the dates were re-screened: %-share has a shared, noisy, cross-channel denominator and is not a reliable measure of whether the target segment's own signal is dominant. See notes/PLAN.md 5.2.
